outcome: Adverse pregnancy outcomes (fetal distress, neonatal asphyxia)
finding: Phloroglucinol combined with oxytocin was associated with a higher Bishop score, shorter labor duration, higher vaginal delivery rate, higher successful induction rate, and lower incidence of adverse outcomes compared to oxytocin alone.
mod_finding: The study found a higher rate of vaginal natural delivery in the group that received phloroglucinol combined with oxytocin.
